meta.name: Mension House Mallesh
meta.description: In a quiet village where gossip spreads faster than the wind, a swaggering young man becomes the talk of the town after his wedding night sparks unexpected rumours. What follows is a hilarious chain of misunderstandings, ego clashes, and small-town chaos. Mension House Mallesh is a lively rural entertainer packed with satire and nonstop laughter.
